brief:
Israeli authorities declared 2,536 dunams of land from three villages northwest of Ramallah as state property, the Ma'an news agency reported. The seizure affects communities in the region as occupation forces expand control over Palestinian territory.

The confiscated land is now classified under Israeli state designation, a move that typically precedes settlement construction or military use in occupied Palestinian areas.
title: Israeli occupation seizes 2,536 dunams from three villages northwest of Ramallah
